post.summary: Trace an AIS from a click (ais_auto.m)
post.description: Body: {processed, raw?, click: [x, y], click2?: [x, y], threshold?, settings?: {smooth, kernel, sigma, ...}, engine?: "fast"}. Clicks are MATLAB axes coordinates (x = column, y = row, pixel centres at 1..n). click2 stands in for the second ginput after re-thresholding; by default the first click is used again. threshold defaults to 0.01, what the original was called with (0 means Otsu, as in the original). engine "fast" is Settings' Method "ais_auto.m (fast)": the same answer, sooner.

post.summary: Find every AIS on an image (auto mode)
post.description: Auto mode. Body: {processed, raw?, threshold?, settings?, start?, exclude?: [[[x, y], ...], ...], engine?: "fast"}. Every AIS found on the image without a click (app/analysis/detect.py); start is both | brighter | dimmer | soma (a .czi only) | fitted | fitted2 | learned, exclude the traces already accepted on it.

Upload them afterwards as for a new one.

Body: {archived}: archive the batch (hidden, results kept) or bring it back.

post.description: Body: {kind: "auto", state, done, total}: how far this person's auto run on the batch has got, so everyone's Batches screen can show it.

post.summary: Mark an image done or not done
post.description: Body: {image, done}: mark an image done by hand (shared progress).
Body: {keys, included}: include these images, or leave them out, for the whole team.
Body: {shares: [{user_id, percent}]}: split the batch among these people (admins). An empty list clears the assignment.
Body: {scope: all | auto}: delete the batch's results (admins), to run it again. The Batches screen offers a backup export first.

sessionCookie.name: session
sessionCookie.description: A browser session. Its POSTs carry csrf_token in the body. The cookie's name is server.cookie_name.

apiKey.description: An API key, as Authorization: Bearer <id>.<secret>.

E400.description: The request was refused as it stands.

E403.description: Not allowed, or a bad csrf_token.

E404.description: No such thing, or this feature is switched off.

E409.description: The record has moved on: an undo too late, or a stale edit.

E503.description: In maintenance mode. Retry-After says when to try again.

display_name.description: The key's owner. On the admin list only.

created_by.description: The admin who made this key for its owner. Absent if the owner made it.

request_id.description: On a 5xx: the reference that finds this failure in the log.

join_path.description: The link to hand out, shown in this response only. A credential: treat it like a password.

version.description: The running build. dev when none was stamped.
